item.text: The installed package query uses fixed positional fields, so an empty release appears as a doubled separator and `strings.Fields` drops its position. I’m changing installed line parsing to preserve that empty slot, while keeping update listing parsing compatible with its existing whitespace format. I’ll also add support for `-src.rpm` filenames and validate their structure.
